ul.li: Rule catalogues are inlined into the critic's system prompt at instruction-build time, so the agent never spends round-trips on list_* tools — it batches get_document_content calls instead (~4 round-trips rather than ~30).
The model is passed at run time (agent.run(..., model=...)), not bound to the agent — agents stay import-safe for tests.
Validators enforce, prompts ask: quote anchoring and AC5 structure preservation are checked programmatically with ModelRetry, not trusted to the prompt.
Agent output models (models.py) are mapped to API schemas (api_schemas.py) in the service — the LLM contract and the API contract can evolve independently.

text.tspan: no tools — findings carry the fix
